statement: Retain v1 authoring migration until an explicit sunset decision.
rationale: The v1 authoring format belongs to pre-public prototypes, and 0.2.0 was the first public distribution with v2. But 0.2.0 shipped a one-way migration promise, and the command, docs and tests still define it. Whether any supported input remains is not knowable from this repository. Removing it as cleanup would break a released contract; decide a deprecation and sunset first.
